scope: Fast failed pre-deploy terminal skips discard a matching recorded Job start; successful, build, cancel and other unknown-time contracts are preserved.
limits: MCP and pinned CLI timestamp reads are source-traced, not live-probed here.
Only owned Free prebuilt web was live-tested. Private/worker and repo-backed, timeout/cancel/supersede/missing-record variants need regression checks; no production writes to those cases.
The raw operator Job start has second precision and can precede the same-second row creation's fractional timestamp. It must not be replaced with row creation or terminal observation time.
The slow failure's existing observation timestamp must remain unchanged; this finding does not move already-recorded starts to earlier Job timestamps.
The later selected pod probe is empty after pod GC; the Job and earlier raw operator status remain available evidence.
Screenshots are local supplementary artifacts; complete native DOM and API evidence below is durable.

existingOwnersConsidered: w6/done/m123: failed builds; no pre-deploy start sourcing
w4/blocked/m156: successful terminal skips, explicitly preserves failure contracts
w1/done/m149: pre-deploy serving phase, reason and log label; those controls pass
